canicule.description: Our summer show is coming! Can you feel the heat? Join us to celebrate (or bemoan) the hottest weeks of the year, and submit your steamiest works of art.

blueprints.posterAlt: Blueprints of Belonging photo exhibition poster
blueprints.description: Blueprints of Belonging is a photographic exhibition that traces a sensitive cartography of the gazes, gestures, and everyday fragments of trans and non-binary people. Created mainly using cyanotypes, the works evoke memory, imprint, and construction — like architectural plans of a belonging in perpetual negotiation. By deconstructing and recomposing faces, the exhibition becomes an act of resistance and reclamation. It builds a living archive where trans lives are not only visible, but rooted, affirmed, and inhabited.
